doc: Detection duties of the reproducibility-tail plant. Each is a producer (the only polling), a signal with max_age, and a resolver role. Exit codes: 0 GREEN, 2 RED, anything else a failed observation that ages to UNKNOWN. For the two queue duties RED means work is owed: a low queue wakes scout, an unclaimed entry wakes rerun.

duties.name: dispatch
duties.covers: a wake left open (started/unknown) longer than 30 minutes

duties.name: queue-low
duties.covers: fewer than five open entries in queue/: the scout is owed a wake to register more pre-registered claims

duties.name: queue-owed
duties.covers: an entry in queue/ with no live claim and no result: rerun is owed a wake; a claim older than six hours without a result counts as unclaimed again

duties.name: push-lag
duties.covers: local main reaches GitHub within a quarter hour (checks/push-lag.py): RED when the oldest unpushed commit is older, or main has diverged; UNKNOWN when the remote cannot be read. The post-commit hook (tools/post-commit-push.sh) pushes after a 30 s settle; the 17-commit backlog of 2026-11-26 had no hook

duties.name: disk-floor
duties.covers: the spare drive under 60 GiB free, or this plant's scratch tree over 20 GiB: rerun takes no new entry and only cleans scratch
